vis-timeline-graph2d.min.js (the standalone build) bundles the libraries below. Each licence follows.
keycharm, vis-data and vis-util are dual licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT, as vis-timeline is (LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt and LICENSE.MIT.txt beside this file).
